message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No newly reported or meaningfully updated vulnerabilities were found in the last 24 hours that could be confidently matched to the components in the DLL-only inventory.

**Scope**

- Source: `DLL_software_component.txt` only; duplicate component names and obvious naming variants were normalized.
- Window: 2026-09-13 13:10 IST through 2026-09-14 13:10 IST (2026-09-13 07:40 UTC through 2026-09-14 07:40 UTC).
- The primary product-list sources were not read or combined with this scan.

**Findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities met the freshness, source-credibility, and product-match requirements. Recent nearby results, including vendor notices published before the cutoff or advisories for adjacent products, were excluded.

**MongoDB ecosystem sweep**

No credible MongoDB-related vulnerability was newly reported or meaningfully updated within the window. The independent sweep covered MongoDB Server (Community and Enterprise), mongod, mongos, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, mongosh, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, and major officially maintained libraries and services. MongoDB was checked even though it is absent from the DLL inventory.

**Sources checked**

[GitHub Advisory Database](https://github.com/advisories), [NVD vulnerability search](https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/search), [CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog](https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog), [MongoDB Alerts](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts), current CVE feeds, and vendor security/advisory pages for the monitored component families.

**Review priority**

No immediate vulnerability review is indicated from this 24-hour scan. Continue routine monitoring; older known vulnerabilities and general version currency were outside this run's scope.
